title: Looking for feedback and testers
author: spock0118
selftext:
Hello! I'm a co-founder of Mangrove, and we're looking for feedback from people using AI for trading. Not trying to shill here.

We have over 100 tools on our MCP server for market data, strategy building, backtesting, risk management, and more. This is shipped with our (https://github.com/MangroveTechnologies/mangrove-agent)\[open-source client\], installable as a plugin, and tested with Claude and Codex, and to some extent Perplexity (albiet I have used Perplexity the least). It brings those tools into your AI assistant and adds scheduling, paper trading, live execution and local evaluation and trade records.

The agent uses our open-source technical indicator and chart pattern library, also on our github, and on PYPI. 

You can also find our MCP listings in the \[Official MCP Registry\](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/?q=mangrove), \[Glama\](https://glama.ai/mcp/connectors/io.github.MangroveTechnologies/mangroveai), \[mcp.so\](https://mcp.so/servers/mangroveai) and \[SourceWeft\](https://sourceweft.com/mcp/io.github.MangroveTechnologies%2Fmangroveai).

Any feedback is much appreciated! I can upgrade any accounts for free, you don't need to use live money to test either (everything defaults to paper mode / testnet).
